about_the_game:
As the player, you will explore eerie ruins in a first-person psychological horror experience. Your task is to search through dark corridors, collect scattered notes, solve puzzles, and survive terrifying encounters while uncovering the mystery hidden inside these ruins.

Devestor features ten handcrafted levels with a mix of atmospheric dread and active monster encounters. Some levels focus on claustrophobic tension and scripted scares, while others unleash roaming creatures that hunt you down, forcing you to carefully plan your movements. The gameplay blends exploration, parkour, and puzzle-solving with sudden moments of pure terror.

The full game offers over two hours of gameplay, while the demo version lets you experience the first two levels (around 30 minutes of playtime). Your journey will test your courage, reflexes, and wits as you face the horrors waiting in the ruins.

Features:

  • First-person psychological horror gameplay

  • 10 handcrafted levels (2 available in the demo)

  • Over 2 hours of tense gameplay in the full version

  • Atmospheric ruins filled with notes, secrets, and disturbing lore

  • A mix of psychological tension and roaming monsters with chase sequences

  • Puzzles, parkour, and environmental challenges

  • Sudden jump scares and scripted horror moments

short_description: Within the haunted ruins lies a hunger that never sleeps. Creepy, tall, and skinny beings lurk in the dark, waiting for the perfect moment to strike. Your only hope rests in the scattered notes left behind by some clueless idiot who ventured here just like you… who never made it back.
